headline: Winless Go Ahead Eagles still favourites against Telstar
summary: Go Ahead Eagles have not won in 5 Eredivisie games, and Sunday brought a 1-4 defeat at PEC Zwolle. The scoreline was worse than the performance: they created 2.76 expected goals in that match. Telstar sit 16th with 6 points and concede 2.35 expected goals a game — that is why the market still makes Go Ahead clear favourites for Friday's home game, at 59.5% across 10 bookmakers, against Telstar's 17.2%. Go Ahead are rated a full goal better, and there is a 51% chance of more than 3.25 goals. They have also signed keeper Jasper Cillessen as cover after Nick Marsman's knee injury.
read: Go Ahead Eagles have not won in five but remain clear home favourites at 59.5%, rated around a goal better than a Telstar side sitting 16th with one win all season. The market expects goals too — a 3.25 line with the over odds-on at 51% — while Cillessen's arrival as goalkeeping cover left the home price untouched.

facts.fact: Go Ahead Eagles are priced as clear favourites for Friday, at 59.5% to win at home.
facts.meaning: The market expects the hosts to end their winless run, even though they have not won any of their last five.

facts.fact: Go Ahead Eagles have drawn four and lost one of their last five Eredivisie games (LDDDD).
facts.meaning: They keep taking points but cannot close games out — a fifth draw of the run would be no surprise to the price.

facts.fact: The market's fair handicap line is -0.97, i.e. Go Ahead are rated roughly one goal better than Telstar.
facts.meaning: A one-goal home win is the 50/50 point of this game — the market sees it as close, but clearly in the hosts' favour.

facts.fact: Go Ahead Eagles lost 1-4 away at PEC Zwolle on Sunday.
facts.meaning: The heaviest scoreline of their run came in the most recent match, five days before this one.

facts.fact: Go Ahead Eagles have signed 37-year-old goalkeeper Jasper Cillessen until the end of the season after back-up keeper Nick Marsman suffered a knee injury.
facts.meaning: Extra goalkeeping cover arrives days before kick-off; Cillessen competes with Kjetil Haug for the starting spot.

facts.fact: Telstar are 16th of 18 in the Eredivisie, with six points from nine games and a goal difference of -8.
facts.meaning: They arrive as the lower-ranked side, five points behind Go Ahead, and have won once in nine.

facts.fact: Telstar's last five league games read LDLDL.
facts.meaning: No win in five for the visitors either, so both teams come in short of a victory.

facts.fact: Telstar have conceded chances at a rate of 2.35 xG per game over their last five.
facts.meaning: They give up real quality, not just volume, which is why the hosts are rated a goal better despite not winning lately.

sources.fact: Go Ahead Eagles have signed 37-year-old goalkeeper Jasper Cillessen on a contract until the end of the season after reserve keeper Nick Marsman suffered a knee injury.
Go Ahead Eagles announced the signing of former Netherlands international Jasper Cillessen on Wednesday evening via their social media channels.
Cillessen will compete with Kjetil Haug for the goalkeeper spot, according to De Telegraaf.

Go Ahead Eagles published very positive annual figures on Tuesday 20 October, with net revenue rising sharply thanks partly to last season's Europa League participation and equity growing significantly.
Telstar lost to Feyenoord on Saturday, in a match where Sem Steijn scored twice for Feyenoord.
